items.title: Amphenol Fell Nearly 6%, But Orders Hit $12 Billion
items.summary: Amphenol (APH) closed at $75.43 on Monday, Nov 16, down 3.6% on the day and 5.7% below its Nov 10 close, the day we asked whether Amphenol stock is really expensive. A reader asked us for more on the stock. After a slide like that, an owner wants one thing answered: does the business still back the growth Wall Street expects for 2027.
